req.title: Player POST accepts nickname optionally
req.statement: The system shall accept POST /players/ payloads without a nickname field and treat nickname as optional.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-040 states that POST /players/ must accept payloads without a nickname field, treating nickname as optional. Examining the source, PlayerRequestModel has no 'nickname' field at all; the optional fields are middle_name, date_of_birth, abbr_position, team, league, and starting11. The requirement is best interpreted as: a minimal valid payload (only required fields: first_name, last_name, squad_number, position) must be accepted with HTTP 201. We test: (1) positive EP — full payload minus any optional fields succeeds with 201 and correct body; (2) negative NEG — payload missing a truly required field (first_name) returns 422; (3) boundary BVA — payload with exactly the minimum required fields (no optional fields at all) returns 201; (4) DT — payload with some optional fields present and some absent returns 201; (5) NEG — payload with an unknown extra field (nickname) is still accepted (FastAPI ignores extra fields by default) and returns 201. Squad numbers are chosen outside the pre-loaded 1-26 range to avoid 409 conflicts.

tests.name: test_post_player_without_optional_fields_returns_201
preconditions: App is running in-process via TestClient
Database contains pre-loaded rows with squad numbers 1-26
Squad number 99 does not exist in the database
actions: POST /players/ with only required fields: first_name, last_name, squad_number, position
Omit all optional fields: middle_name, date_of_birth, abbr_position, team, league, starting11
expected: HTTP 201 Created
Response body contains id (UUID), first_name, last_name, squad_number, position
Optional fields in response are null/None
trace: R-PLAYER-040: system shall accept POST /players/ without optional fields
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_without_optional_fields_returns_201():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "TestFirst",
        "lastName": "TestLast",
        "squadNumber": 99,
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["firstName"] == "TestFirst"
    assert body["lastName"] == "TestLast"
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 99
    assert body["position"] == "Goalkeeper"
    assert body["middleName"] is None
    assert body["dateOfBirth"] is None
    assert body["abbrPosition"] is None
    assert body["team"] is None
    assert body["league"] is None
    assert body["starting11"] is None
    assert "id" in body

test_post_player_without_optional_fields_returns_201()
